name: Ocean Pavilion
tagline: Wake to the sound of the tide
description: A single open pavilion at the edge of the dunes, with a plunge pool and a daybed facing the bay.
longDescription: Set on the first line of the dunes, each Ocean Pavilion opens fully to the sea. Sliding teak screens fold away to join the bedroom, veranda and plunge pool into one long room in the breeze. An outdoor rain shower sits in a walled garden of beach morning glory, and the daybed faces east for sunrise.

name: Garden Sanctuary
tagline: A private walled garden of frangipani
description: A courtyard suite wrapped around its own garden, with a sunken stone bath and a reading veranda.
longDescription: Garden Sanctuaries face inward, around a walled courtyard of frangipani, ferns and a still reflecting pool. Shade moves slowly across the lime-washed walls through the day. The sunken stone bath opens to the sky, and a second sleeping room makes it ideal for families.

name: Horizon Villa
tagline: Two pavilions and an infinity pool on the headland
description: A two-bedroom villa on the headland with an infinity pool, rooftop sunset deck and a separate living pavilion.
longDescription: On the rocky headland at the end of the bay, the Horizon Villa is arranged as a small compound: two bedroom pavilions, a living and dining pavilion, and an eighteen-metre infinity pool that seems to run straight into the Indian Ocean. Climb to the rooftop deck for sunset, or ask for a private chef to cook in the villa kitchen.
